article.abstract: The investigators used linear regression with adjustment for age, and separately analysed a subgroup of women without adjustment. article.title: SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT FIXTURE 5: invented substances and findings
article.abstract: The fictional diet Fendra was compared with a control diet. For outcome Gemin, the mean difference was -2 units with a 95% confidence interval from -5 to 1, was not statistically significant, and the authors did not confirm a difference. For outcome Helin, the mean difference was -4 units and was significant (p=0.01).

article.title: SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT FIXTURE 6: invented substances and findings
article.abstract: The study examined fictional biomarker Ivrin and subgroup differences. Higher Ivrin was associated with lower outcome Jorin; the interaction with age had p=0.03, and significance of the main association was not reported. In relation to Ivrin, outcome Korin increased, but the comparison group and time point were not stated.
